valuation_template_rationale: A listed holding company dominated by quoted Tencent value plus unlisted platforms requires look-through NAV with explicit private-asset, debt, tax, governance and persistent-discount adjustments.
bear_assumptions: Tencent weakens, private values receive severe haircuts, central debt and capital allocation absorb value, and the holding discount stays wide despite repurchases.
base_assumptions: Tencent and profitable ecommerce assets sustain look-through value, unlisted marks are haircutted, and open-ended repurchases add per-share NAV while a material discount persists.
bull_assumptions: Tencent compounds, ecommerce cash flow broadens, private marks prove conservative, repurchases continue and governance/capital allocation support partial discount narrowing.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only after current look-through evidence and an accepted relationship clear all economic and governance gates; downgrade if Tencent value, private-asset economics or buyback accretion weaken, net debt rises, or capital allocation destroys per-share NAV.
